messages.subject: Re: DataTable/Shiny Styling Issue
parts:
Thousand separator:
I wasnt able to find how to do it on the fly in the table so I used this approach to manipulate data prior putting it into table:
data$VAR <- format(data$VAR, big.mark=',', scientific=FALSE)
